name: Kanban Board
description: A live Kanban board: every open AI tab is a card, cards drag between columns, a switcher moves between one project's board and a Global board of every project, and clicking a card jumps Maestro to that tab.

permissions.reason: Enumerate agents to build and label cards.
List the toolTypes of agents you already run, so the conductor settings surface offers only a provider you can actually pick.

Enumerate AI tabs and their live status to build and update cards, and - only when you turn on "close tabs when cards close" - close a card's own tab when that card ages out of Done, never while it is busy.
Jump Maestro to the tab behind a clicked card.
Create exactly one conductor agent per board, in its own scratch folder, when you ask for one. Never spawns anything else.
Hand a board's conductor the project roots you have granted, as read-only added directories, and keep that in sync. Never widens reach beyond what you have already approved.
Keep the board live as agents and tabs change.
Render the Kanban board panel.
Offer open, refresh, and clear-placements as commands.
Put one "Kanban Board" launcher button in the Left Bar's action row, so the board is reachable without remembering its keybinding. Runs the same open command the palette does and nothing else.
Remember where a card was placed.
Remember where a card was placed.
Surface failures, such as a trimmed or failed board update.
Read the global column definitions. Only reads its own board files under ~/.maestro and never touches a project folder.
Read a project's own board file. Only reads its own board files under ~/.maestro and never touches a project folder.
Write the global column definitions. Only writes its own board files under ~/.maestro and never touches a project folder.
Write a project's own board file. Only writes its own board files under ~/.maestro and never touches a project folder.
Read the archive of cards retired from Done. The plugin keeps retired cards here and nowhere else, under ~/.maestro, and never touches a project folder.

Read a board conductor's own scratch folder. Holds only the conductor's scratch space and plan files, under ~/.maestro, and never touches a project folder.
Write a board conductor's own scratch folder, starting with its README. Holds only the conductor's scratch space and plan files, under ~/.maestro, and never touches a project folder.
Shows recent History only for agents it created or you approved, and can therefore never reach the network.
Messages typed on a card go only to that card's agent and tab, and only after you approve that agent once or if the board created it.
